definition_en: a date or time by which something must be finished
example_en: Our team finished the report before the deadline.
example_id: Tim kami menyelesaikan laporan sebelum tenggat waktu.

definition_en: a person you work with in a job
example_en: My colleague helped me prepare the presentation.
example_id: Rekan kerja saya membantu saya menyiapkan presentasi.

definition_en: money you receive every month for your job
example_en: She receives a higher salary in her new job.
example_id: Dia menerima gaji yang lebih tinggi di pekerjaan barunya.

definition_en: travelling from one place to another
example_en: The train journey took almost four hours.
example_id: Perjalanan kereta itu memakan waktu hampir empat jam.

definition_en: bags and suitcases you carry when travelling
example_en: We left our luggage at the hotel reception.
example_id: Kami menitipkan koper kami di resepsi hotel.

definition_en: a list showing the times of classes or transport
example_en: The new school timetable starts on Monday.
example_id: Jadwal sekolah yang baru dimulai hari Senin.

definition_en: a task that a teacher gives to students
example_en: The teacher gave us an assignment for the weekend.
example_id: Guru memberi kami tugas untuk akhir pekan.

definition_en: the set of keys you press to type on a computer
example_en: He typed the password using the keyboard.
example_id: Dia mengetik kata sandi menggunakan papan ketik.

definition_en: a secret word that lets you use a computer account
example_en: Never share your password with strangers.
example_id: Jangan pernah membagikan kata sandi kepada orang asing.

definition_en: damage to air or water caused by harmful substances
example_en: Air pollution is a serious problem in big cities.
example_id: Polusi udara adalah masalah serius di kota-kota besar.

definition_en: to process used materials so they can be used again
example_en: Our office recycles paper and plastic bottles.
example_id: Kantor kami mendaur ulang kertas dan botol plastik.

definition_en: an arranged meeting with a doctor
example_en: I have a dentist appointment tomorrow morning.
example_id: Saya ada janji dengan dokter gigi besok pagi.

definition_en: a body temperature higher than normal when you are ill
example_en: The child stayed home because he had a fever.
example_id: Anak itu tinggal di rumah karena ia demam.
